records.title: Forensic Audit of Bibb County Sheriff’s Office Flock Safety Search Logs
records.description: Independent forensic audit of 3,663 Flock Safety ALPR searches performed by 63 Bibb County Sheriff’s Office user accounts between May 1 and June 1, 2026. The report examines case-number documentation, searches lacking identifiable case references, concentrated user activity, off-hours usage and repeated high-volume lookup sessions.
